content.text: Identify the contact point between the person's right hand and the coffee machine. The 2D coordinates are normalized between 0 and 1000, where 0 0 is the top left and 1000 1000 is the bottom right. Choices:  A. 657 583. B. 825 676. C. 978 417. D. 394 596. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
